From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Jasmine — quick architecture notes (high level):

- Feasible: VPC + on-prem customer MTL (managed transit) approach fits our current Private model; no fundamental runtime changes required for Q3 pilot.
- KMS: We can integrate customer-managed KMS via our KMS plugin: requires HSM-certified key escrow support on their side and an IP allowlist for KMS endpoints (nonstandard network egress).
- Network: Their firewall team will require a single outbound IP range for telemetry and metrics; we can provide a NAT egress pool but it will be tied to dedicated capacity (Reserved pool).
- Data residency: For on-prem variant, data remains in-customer network; for VPC, need contract clause about ephemeral caches and KV cache TTLs.
- Nonstandard work:
  * Custom kernel tuning for older GPU families (if they insist on on-prem heterogeneous hardware) — +4w engineering to validate.
  * Certificate-authority onboarding for mutual TLS (mTLS) — ops/devsec: ~2w.

Deliverables I can produce by Wed EOD:
- Updated network diagram (attached) with IP ranges & port list.
- Short list of model variants compatible with expected latency SLO.

Karthik
Principal Infra Architect

Adding resourcing and gating perspective:

- Pilot resourcing (8-week pilot):
  * SRE: 1.5 FTE (on-call rotation, runbook creation, playbook for fallback)
  * Infra Eng: 0.75 FTE (setup & tuning for reserved pool)
  * Security Reviewer: 0.25 FTE (audit review, KMS mTLS verification)
  * Solutions Eng: 0.5 FTE (customer onboarding, runbook walkthrough)
  => Rough estimate: 3 FTEs for pilot period (time-limited).
- Ongoing (post-handoff): we expect a committed Dedicated pool with 0.3 FTE ops support for the first 3 months, then move to standard support tiers.
- SLA exceptions likely: 99.9% uptime target will need review; given isolated network + custom KMS, offer 99.5% for first 6 months or an exception letter.
- Compliance/gating checklist items to present to CedarBridge procurement:
  1) SOC-2+ evidence packet (we have a redacted pack)
  2) KMS onboarding guide & responsibilities matrix (who rotates keys, who stores audit logs)
  3) Network egress IPs & proposed NAT pool (from Karthik)
  4) Runbook & escalation paths (SRE primary contact)
  5) Exception approval timeline (we need 2-week legal turn for contract clause on ephemeral caches)

I'll attach a quick XLS with the FTE breakdown and expected burn (resourcing_scenarios.xlsx).
